item.title: School suspension as a predictor of young adult homelessness: The International Youth Development Study
item.description: This study examines school suspension as a longitudinal predictor of young adult homelessness using data from the International Youth Development Study. The authors identify school exclusion as an early-life marker of later housing instability and discuss prevention implications.
